home.aboutWhat: "C'est de Gauche ou de Droite ?" (Is It Left-Wing or Right-Wing?) is a free, 100% anonymous game: everyday objects, concepts and symbols come up as cards, and it's up to you to decide. Quinoa, rib steak, cargo bikes… everything gets sorted, with humour and no political agenda whatsoever.
home.aboutHow: The idea is simple: swipe each card to the left or to the right depending on the side you associate it with. After each vote, see what the community thinks. Play solo, challenge your friends in private multiplayer rooms, or search for a specific item to see how it ranks.
home.aboutStats: Every game feeds the stats: thousands of votes draw a collective — and often hilarious — map of our political clichés. Browse all the items to discover the community's verdicts, and suggest your own card ideas right from the game.

credits.privacyBody: The game is 100% anonymous: no account, no personal data collection. Only ads may collect data, and only with your consent (they can be disabled in the settings). An IP hash is used to prevent abuse: it is kept for 30 days and cannot be traced back to the original IP. When a card depicts a real person, votes do not attribute any actual opinion to them: they only reflect aggregated, anonymous player perceptions, for fun. Anyone depicted can request the removal of their card (see Reporting & removal).
credits.disclaimerBody: This game is meant purely for fun. The votes are never manipulated, and the results reflect only how players swipe — not reality, and no political truth of any kind. Nothing here should be taken seriously, nor used to judge, target, or harass anyone. I decline any affiliation and any responsibility for how the content is interpreted, and I wholeheartedly encourage kindness, respect, and good values. Play, laugh, and be nice to one another. Brands and people appearing in the game are mentioned for reference only: no affiliation, partnership or endorsement is implied.
credits.takedownBody: Every card can be flagged with the “Report” button: past a certain number of reports, it is automatically hidden pending moderation. If you are depicted on a card, or hold rights to it (trademark, image, copyright), you can request its removal by email (see Contact): any manifestly unlawful content is removed promptly.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.introBody: This page describes the data processed by the game "C'est de Gauche ou de Droite ?" (cestdegaucheoudedroite.com) and your rights. In short: the game works without any account or personal data; only ads may collect some, with your consent.
privacy.whoBody: The site is published by SOARES Cloud Engineering Services, SARL (French LLC) with share capital of €1,000, SIREN 999 871 148, 78 F rue de Lambersart, 59350 Saint-André-lez-Lille, France. Host: Cloudflare, Inc., 101 Townsend Street, San Francisco, CA 94107, USA.
privacy.dataBody: No account is required and the game itself collects no personal data. A random session identifier, generated on your device, is only used to prevent duplicate votes: it is not linked to any identity. To fight abuse, a fingerprint (hash) of your IP address is computed: it cannot be traced back to the original address and is automatically erased after 30 days. Your votes are aggregated anonymously into the game's public statistics, and your vote history is stored on your device only.
privacy.cookiesBody: The game is funded by advertising, served through Google AdSense. Google and its certified partners may use cookies or similar identifiers to serve ads, measure their audience and, if you consent, personalise them. Without consent, only non-personalised ads may be shown. Outside of advertising, the site sets no tracking cookies.
privacy.consentBody: On your first visit from the European Economic Area or the United Kingdom, a consent banner (Google CMP) lets you accept or refuse advertising cookies, and change your choice at any time. You can also disable ads entirely in the game's settings.

about.title: About & FAQ
about.whatBody: "C'est de Gauche ou de Droite ?" starts from a well-known bar-room debate: everything, absolutely everything, can be politically classified — quinoa, rib steak, cargo bikes, flip-flops. The game turns that debate into a collective quiz: cards go by, you decide, and everyone's votes draw a tenderly absurd map of our political clichés.
about.methodBody: Every vote is anonymous and counts for one: no weighting, no editorial adjustment. A random session identifier limits duplicate votes (one vote per item per session), and an IP-address fingerprint, kept for at most 30 days, is used solely to block obvious abuse. The displayed percentages are recomputed continuously from aggregated counters — what you see is the real state of the votes as you play.
about.moderationBody: All items are suggested by players and manually validated before appearing in the game. Every card can be reported with one button; past a threshold of reports it is automatically hidden pending review. Takedown requests (people depicted, rights holders) are handled with priority by e-mail.
about.faqA1: No — that's the whole point. The percentages reflect aggregated perceptions of players having fun, not actual political positions. Nothing here is a study, a poll, or a judgement about anyone.
about.faqQ2: How do I suggest a new item?
about.faqA2: Use the free search: if the item doesn't exist, a button offers to submit it. It will appear in the game once approved by moderation.
about.faqA3: Every card has a "Report" button. For a takedown request (image, brand, person depicted), write to us directly — clearly unlawful content is removed quickly.
about.faqA4: An independent French developer, with the community's help for item ideas. The full legal notice is on the Credits page.
about.faqA5: Through advertising (Google AdSense), which you can disable in the settings. The game sells no data — it barely collects any: see the privacy policy.
